name: Cyclical Recurrences
storyline: You awake in your room, same as any other day. A fog outside makes it hard to see. You walk downstairs, but mom is gone. Probably out shopping. You grab an apple on your way out, but upon opening the front door...the world you know is no longer the same. Instead, a bizarre amalgamation of buildings greets you, signposts waywardly pointing out colour names. Pewter. Fuchsia. Vermilion. These places are familiar, and yet different. Shifting, swirling, blending together and pulling apart. Do you remember? Are you willfully forgetting?​
summary:
In Cyclical Recurrences, you take control of your character as you explore a strange new world. Doors lead everywhere, caves sprawl out in impossible spaces, and mountains stand where they didn't before. You may find friendly faces, some of which will give you special effects (abilities) to help you explore farther. Along the way, you may also come across shiny icons. You feel compelled to collect them. Maybe something good will happen when you get all 8.

This game is a surreal exploration-styled game with retro Pokemon graphics. While there is an "end goal" of sorts, the main appeal is exploring new landscapes, relaxing, and making your own meaning in a bizarre arrangement of landscapes.
